newsitem.title: USA: Russia admitted to Paris Club.
newsitem.headline: Russia admitted to Paris Club.

text.p: U.S. President Bill Clinton and Russian President Boris Yeltsin announced on Friday that Russia had been admitted to the Paris Club of creditor nations.

"I'm very pleased," Clinton told reporters at the start of a meeting with Yeltsin ahead of a summit of the Group of Seven industrialized nations. "What you see here is a sweeping integration of Russia into the major decision making networks of the world in a way that is very positive for the rest of us."
"I just received some good news, so I'm in a good mood," Yeltsin said.
Russia, which inherited both the debts and the obligations of the former Soviet Union, has won a series of deals to reschedule Soviet-era debts.
Moscow had sought to join the Paris Club as a creditor in an effort to win back some debts extended to Soviet allies, most of them in the developing world.
